Eine  flexible Beschäftigung als Minijob oder Werkstudent*in  mit einem Umfang von ca.  8 Stunden pro Woche . Die Arbeitszeiten können in Abstimmung flexibel gestaltet werden; eine regelmäßige Anwesenheit in unserem Büro ist dabei wünschenswert.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

UX research at Anthropic works across products used by millions of people, on interactions that don't have established conventions yet. We inform critical decisions through rigorous research, working closely with curious, open-minded stakeholders who are eager to learn along with us. We combine qualitative and quantitative methods to understand user needs in a space that's evolving faster than anyone can track. We move fast, favor impact over polish, and increasingly build our own tools, deeply leveraging Claude to do research at the speed and rigor this environment demands.

This role is on the Platform research team, embedded in Anthropic's Platform organization, which comprises the API, the agent and connector infrastructure developers build on top of it, and the Console, SDKs, and documentation they use to do it. A large share of what gets built with Claude is built on this platform, including many of Anthropic's own products, and the people who use it range from individual developers to the largest enterprises.

The teams that build the platform are deeply technical, move quickly, and are deeply curious about and engaged with users. User research's job here is to give them a deeper and more systematic understanding of those users than they can get on their own, and to help the organization decide what to build for them next.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with a great deal of autonomy. You'll work with the rest of the Platform user research team and with Platform's leaders to decide where research can make the biggest difference, and then lead that work yourself.

Key responsibilities

  • Work with Platform's leaders and teams to understand what they most need to know about the people building on Claude, decide what is and isn't worth studying, and own that agenda
  • Design and run the research yourself using both qualitative and quantitative methods
  • Study the full range of people the platform serves: developers, the teams and companies building products on it, and the people who administer and buy it
  • Communicate findings to product managers, designers, and engineers and follow them through to product decisions, while building the shared understanding of users that lets teams make good calls on their own
  • Build the tools and infrastructure that let research keep pace with the platform, using Claude heavily and inventing methods where the existing ones don't fit

Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows. Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.

jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

This is a rare opportunity to build a truly strategic Deal Desk function at Perk — one that shapes how our Sales organisation structures, prices, and closes its most complex, high-value deals. You'll take ownership of the Deal Desk team and its transformation, personally running point on our most complex and strategic deals while building a team that operates as trusted commercial partners to Sales, Finance, and Legal. A major part of the role will be modernising how the team works: automating manual processes through AI and automation, and improving our CPQ and quoting systems so Sales can move faster with confidence.  This is a coach-player role: you'll lead and develop a team while staying hands-on with the deals that matter most.

jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Every RELEX implementation is a solution built from scratch for one customer: their processes, their data, their targets. (Senior) Supply Chain Consultants shape both sides of that build — the business processes and KPIs the customer will run on, and the configuration that makes them work in the system. jobs.title: Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement
jobs.description:
Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement

Location: Remote — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.

The Role

The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.

Top Responsibilities:

Client Measurement & Data Strategy

• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.

• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.

• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.

• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.

• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.

Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving

• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.

• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.

• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.

• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.

Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.

• Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights.

• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools.

• Drive innovation across APVision

Roblox is reimagining the way people come together to connect, create, and express themselves. To support our massive scale, we are powered by thousands of microservices. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Engine DataModel team, you will own and innovate on the foundational components that form the backbone of the Roblox platform. In the Roblox Engine, the DataModel is a tree-like structure that is analogous to a scenegraph in other 3D engines. This role will report to the engineering manager and will be based out of our HQ in San Mateo, CA in a hybrid model 3 days a week (Tuesdays to Thursdays).

Our team owns:

  • The core structures and systems are used to build the DataModel and interact with it.
  • The C++ reflection bindings that form the Engine’s Luau API surface and let creators interact with the DataModel. We’ve built custom codegen tooling to generate the C++ for these reflection bindings and other related structures.
  • DataModel serialization … and much more!

You will:

  • Develop engine code that performs well for all user-created games on the Roblox platform.
  • Build the core systems and data structures used in the Roblox engine, working with other teams to find universal solutions.
  • Take ownership of projects throughout their full lifecycles.
  • Execute code that performs well on all the devices Roblox supports—from desktop clients to mobile phone clients to console clients.

You have:

  • Experience developing outstanding systems-level C++ programming.
  • Have experience working on game engine internals
  • Responsibility for building and maintaining systems that work optimally.
  • Curiosity to learn and stay up-to-date on technology developments.
  • Have a curiosity about the actual work the CPU does when you use smart pointers, templates, virtual functions, and blocks of memory, both structured and raw.

jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Join some of the best Graphics Engineers in the world supporting the largest immersive 3D streaming environment deployed across console, desktop, mobile, and VR.

  • Scalability: Roblox provides a platform that guarantees to the creators that their games will always and automatically run on different devices, with cross-platform play and minimal load times.
  • Compatibility: Roblox games and assets made in the past, are still working today. Rendering has to have an eye to the past, and an eye to the future…
  • Community: Roblox games are made by creators of all experience levels, from professionals who earn their living on the platform to kids who are learning to program using Roblox!

As a Rendering Engineer, you will solve difficult challenges, while continuing to build a high-speed, completely dynamic environments connected on all devices.

Many established rendering techniques do not trivially apply to our platform - novel solutions are needed as we push Roblox towards higher targets of visual fidelity. Even the simpler visuals we support on low-power devices are enabled by some creative rendering ideas, often centered around caching, incremental computation and graceful degradation.

All of this is based on an in-house rendering engine built from the ground up, supporting DirectX 9/11, OpenGL, GNM, Metal, and Vulkan GAPI's. We have a powerful need for top-notch, low-level and high-level graphics work.

You Will:

  • Help investigate and implement rendering techniques to make ROBLOX graphics more immersive and expressive
  • Learn about our community and work with technical artists to understand the present and future needs of our creators
  • Help improve the performance and stability of our game engine
  • Work with other engineering and art teams
  • Take ownership of a project throughout its full lifecycle

jobs.title: SRE Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world's most experienced core blockchain infrastructure companies, having built and pioneered some of the most advanced technologies in the blockchain sector. Parity was founded by Dr. Gavin Wood, co-founder and former CTO of Ethereum, the primary engineer behind the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), inventor of the Solidity programming language, and primary author of the Ethereum Yellowpaper.

People in Our Collective Are

Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger

Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex

Autonomous workers that self-initiate, but also collaborate well with others

Taking maximum accountability and having minimum ego at work

Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space

Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider ecosystem

About the Team

The SRE team is responsible for the infrastructure that makes the Polkadot platform and technology work: test and production network environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and the systems that developers, node operators, and end-user applications across the ecosystem rely on. This spans the full stack from runtime and parachain development environments through to infrastructure supporting live applications and events.  We run environments at different stability tiers, from fast-moving test networks with daily automated updates to production networks with 24/7 on-call coverage. It's a small team, so the role carries broad scope.

The Role

We're looking for an engineering manager who can lead a team of experienced SRE engineers and raise the standard of what reliability looks like in a blockchain infrastructure context.  The team is technically capable. What it needs is someone who can set engineering direction, build the conditions for good work, and think clearly about reliability as a discipline: SLOs, error budgets, blameless postmortems.

What We're Looking For

Systems thinking.  You have a genuine understanding of distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure. You don't need to be the most senior engineer technically, but you need to be credible to people who are.

Reliability.  You've worked in or led a team that takes SRE seriously. You know what error budgets are actually for, when SLOs are miscalibrated, and how to run postmortems that improve things.

Automation.  You get uncomfortable when skilled engineers spend time on work a machine could do. You've built teams that automate away the repetitive work rather than just absorbing it.

People development.  You have a track record of engineers growing under your leadership, ideally some of them moving on to bigger things.

Comfort with unusual territory.  Blockchain infrastructure has properties that don't map cleanly onto standard cloud operations. You don't need prior Web3 experience, but you shouldn't be put off by it either.

Working at Parity

Remote-first, with offices in Berlin,

As an Economy Fraud engineer, you defend Roblox from all types of fraud, including theft, scams, money laundering, and payment fraud.

Roblox is a high-growth, unique product environment. You will be developing anti-fraud and abuse solutions for web, mobile, and 3D environments. This high impact work and your innovation is critical for the well-being of our community and to the future of our company. We aim for our users to have peace of mind that their communities and transactions are protected. Our defenses also protect our company’s rapid expansion and safeguard billions in revenue. Roblox’s virtual marketplace handles over 4 million transactions a day, and enables our top developers to make millions of dollars a year.

Our team’s challenges are not just regular day-to-day technical challenges. Fraud and abuse approaches need to shift over time, depending on the current behaviors of fraudsters. As an Economy Fraud engineer, you will be in a data-driven environment developing both classical and novel approaches to detect and prevent this bad behavior.

You Have:

  • 4+ years of professional experience working with scalable, distributed systems
  • Strong experience in large-scale, data-driven architecture, API design, data modeling, and SQL / NoSQL data storage.
  • Experience in risk prevention, machine learning, or analytical work. Risk prevention may include but is not limited to anti-Fraud, anti-Abuse, or Trust & Safety. Analytical work may include but is not limited to Data Analysis, Scientific Computing, Statistical Modeling, or Research.

jobs.title: Principal QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Riot Games Sydney is looking for a Principal QA Engineer to help transform how we approach quality across teams. Sydney partners with Riot teams globally and contributes across games and technology spaces including VALORANT, League of Legends, Teamfight Tactics, and broader R&D and tech initiatives.

At Riot, quality is more than defect discovery. It is a set of values, practices, and behaviors that shape how we build, decide, and deliver for players.

As a Principal QA Engineer, you will own the quality approach for our teams or product spaces and operate as a senior craft leader with dev studio and business-unit level influence. This role will work closely with and adjacent to the Senior Leadership Team in Sydney, helping shape strategic quality direction across the organisation. You will help teams shift quality left through stronger test automation, better tooling, clearer standards, and practical quality strategies that improve both developer experience and player experience. You will also help teams maintain confidence in quality in a world of AI-assisted development, where new tooling and workflows are changing how software is designed, implemented, and validated.

This is a full-time role, based in Sydney, Australia.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the quality approach for teams or product areas and ensure quality activities are considered across every stage of the software development lifecycle.
  • Lead initiatives that shift quality left through automation, tooling, and process improvements that help engineers catch issues earlier and ship with more confidence.
  • Identify, create, and evolve test frameworks and automation strategies that improve speed, coverage, sustainability, and reliability release over release.
  • Help define and implement test approaches as part of an overall quality and test strategy.
  • Help shape our approach to quality in an evolving AI landscape, including how teams use AI-assisted workflows responsibly and effectively while maintaining confidence in what we ship.
  • Use metrics and reporting to surface quality risks, trends, and opportunities, then turn those insights into action with product and discipline leaders.
  • Provide craft leadership and coaching for QA and partner disciplines, strengthening test design, planning, execution, and quality decision-making.
  • Help define, adapt, and socialise quality standards and practices that are usable across multiple teams and scalable at product or business-unit level.
  • Partner with engineering, delivery, design, creative, and production leaders to diagnose product and project quality risks and recommend targeted improvements.
  • Contribute to growing the quality craft through hiring, mentorship, and cross-team leadership.
  • Work in partnership with Game and Central teams to drive strategic initiatives.

The Game Engine team at Roblox works on the systems that power the experiences at the heart of the metaverse. Our code is the technical foundation in our client, editor, and our simulation servers.

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

  • Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
  • Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
  • Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. A single well-designed primitive or optimization here makes hundreds of internal engineer

Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies, which we advise on issues in the areas of analytics, big data and machine learning. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
What you can expect from us  We are building a new team that takes end-to-end ownership of AI initiatives – from strategy through to production. In many AI projects, there is a gap between the strategy and what ultimately makes it into production and creates real business value. That is exactly the gap we close.

Our work does not stop at the concept stage, nor does it begin with a finished specification. An initiative stays in the same hands from the first idea to a production system that delivers measurable impact. We are driven by outcomes, not by the traditional consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies.

You will join the founding team and help shape what we build, not just how we build it. We work with the latest models and tools and choose the technologies we need to deliver the best results for our clients. There is no prescribed tech stack – we use the right tool for each challenge.
This role goes well beyond traditional AI engineering. You will shape technical solutions from the initial idea through to production and work closely with senior decision-makers on both the client and management side.

What you’ll do as part of our new FDE team:

You own the architecture and technical delivery of the AI solution end to end – from strategy through to production.  You build agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations in real-world enterprise environments.  Agentic coding tools are part of your daily workflow: you use them to build solutions, accelerate code reviews, and create deployment pipelines.  You are involved from the very first idea, not just once the specification is finalized – giving you the opportunity to grow deeper into the strategic and commercial side of the business.  You stay accountable through to the outcome: you do not hand off responsibility but drive the solution all the way through until it is live and delivering measurable impact.  You own and defend your technical decisions directly at the executive level, leading these conversations yourself rather than through an intermediary.

Who you are

You take ownership of the entire outcome, not just one part of it.  You stay accountable until the solution is live in production and delivering measurable impact. You bring a founder and product mindset rather than simply executing assigned tasks.

You build hands-on, at the highest level – and think beyond the code.  From an engineering perspective, you have already deployed LLM-based systems to production and understand the business rationale behind them, not just the architecture.

You can hold your own at the executive level.  You have personally owned and defended technical decisions in front of senior executives. You bring that experience with you – this is not something we will first need to develop.  A proven track record of taking LLM-based systems into production – ideally in a  Forward-Deployed Engineer or Founding Engineer role.

Excellent, production-grade Python skill

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. Un produit qui tient ses promesses  : Nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session – pas besoin de six mois de POC.

What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.  Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.  That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

About the team 
Security Engineering is a team of five covering cloud security, detection, and security operations. They work directly in the Azure estate and are close to the infrastructure, not abstracted behind a policy layer. The team runs Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, and Defender for Cloud, and manages tooling through infrastructure-as-code. jobs.title: Partnerships Lead (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Most partnerships roles are measured on how many logos get signed. This one is measured on revenue and credibility per partner. You'll own a deliberately small portfolio: a handful of integration partners, one or two strategic channel plays, and a network of industry experts that doesn't exist yet.  doinstruct builds software that trains and enables frontline teams: the people in plants, logistics hubs, on construction sites and in food production who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. Series A, 400+ customers, currently opening the US market. Our partners are consultancies and vendors in workplace safety and quality management, at home in the German Mittelstand, and they'll know inside ten minutes whether you understand their world.  Partnerships here used to mean three motions at once, over a hundred partners, and too little time for any of them. We're resetting that and getting specific about each motion. What's left is a short list, and you run it.  You're taking on a one-person function. No team, no SDRs warming up your first conversations, and no playbook for the expert network motion. Part of your first months is telling partners they're no longer a priority. If you want to continue an existing structure, you won't enjoy this.

🎯 What you'll own

Own the handful of integration partners we've already decided to go deep on, end to end.

Build a channel motion with strategic platform partners and get it to the point where their reps have a reason to bring us into the conversation.

Build a network of vertical industry experts from zero: practitioners and operators from food, logistics, construction and manufacturing who refer business and vouch for us inside their industries.

Decide which partnerships aren't worth your time, and have those conversations yourself.

Work with GTM Engineering to turn partner activity into structured signal, so partner context sits in the deal rather than in your head or a spreadsheet.

Keep partner battlecards, positioning and training content current without rewriting them by hand every quarter.

Make partnerships a pipeline source that Sales, Marketing and Customer Experience rely on.

🙋 Who you are

At least three years in a channel or partnerships motion in B2B SaaS, as the core job and not as a side responsibility inside marketing or customer success.

You've taken a partnership from signature to first deal and can walk through the mechanics: which reps you enabled, what incentive they had, where the referral entered the funnel.

You've carried a number yourself, in partnerships or earlier in sales.

You've built relationships with senior stakeholders at much larger platform companies and sat through the slow quarters an integration-led channel motion involves.

Ideally you worked in the Mittelstand, in logistics, in trade or in a production environment before you moved into tech.

You use AI tools daily and have built something with them that takes work off your plate. Which tool doesn't matter.

jobs.title: Social Media & Content Manager (m/w/d), Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 20h, 100% Remote
jobs.description:
Du kommst aus NRW und hast Bock mit Social Media organische Reichweite aufzubauen, die direkten Einfluss auf unsere Performance hat? Du willst Kanäle nicht verwalten, sondern selbst bespielen, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Reel? Dann lies weiter.

Damit wir uns nicht missverstehen: Wir suchen keine reine Redaktionsplan-Verwaltung, die Content einplant, den jemand anderes produziert. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Kanäle in die Hand nimmt. Du suchst die Creatorinnen, du schreibst, was gedreht werden soll, du schneidest, du postest, du antwortest und du sprichst unsere Ads ein. Und du zeigst dich selbst: in unseren Stories, vor der Kamera, mit deiner Stimme. Wenn du lieber im Hintergrund bleibst, passt es nicht. Bei uns liegt Organic komplett bei dir.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest unsere organische Präsenz, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Post. Sivara ist eine Damen-Unterwäsche- und Umstandsmode-Brand mit über 120.000 Kundinnen, unsere Community redet viel mit uns, und genau da entsteht dein Content.

Du bespielst Instagram und TikTok mit Reels, Stories und Posts, sodass wir präsent sind.

Du produzierst und schneidest selbst: aus Creator-Material und eigenen Aufnahmen baust du Videos, die unser Produkt richtig in Szene setzen.

Du betreust unsere Community auf Instagram und Facebook, beantwortest Kommentare und Nachrichten und erkennst dabei, welche Fragen immer wieder kommen. Aus genau diesen Fragen machst du dann Stories und Reels, die sie beantworten.

Du findest neue UGC-Creatorinnen, die zu uns passen, verhandelst Barter-Deals und arbeitest mit Plattformen wie Trybe, etc.

Du schreibst die Shootinglisten für unsere Creatorinnen, sammelst das Material ein und sortierst es so, dass wir damit arbeiten können.

Du stehst selbst vor der Kamera: eine Story aus deinem Alltag, ein spontanes Video aus dem Lager, eine Ansage an die Community. Und du wirkst bei unseren Ad-Creatives mit, wenn wir dich brauchen.

Du sprichst die Voice-Over für unsere Ads ein.

Du betreust unsere Affiliate- und Deal-Partner, findest neue Partner und baust den Kanal mit aus.

Du entwickelst, wie unsere Kanäle klingen und aussehen, schaust dir an was funktioniert hat und was nicht, und planst den nächsten Monat danach.

Qualifikation

Erfahrung im Social Media Marketing oder in der Content-Produktion, idealerweise für eine Brand oder im E-Commerce.

Du schneidest selbst und sicher, mit CapCut, Premiere oder einem vergleichbaren Tool.

Du hast eine angenehme, natürliche Sprechstimme und Lust darauf, regelmäßig Voice-Over einzusprechen.

Du bist extrovertiert und stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera. In die Kamera sprechen, ins Mikro sprechen, dich in unseren Stories mit deinem Gesicht zeigen, ist für dich kein Problem.

Du erkennst Formate und Trends früh und probierst sie aus, statt darauf zu warten, dass jemand sie freigibt.

Du triffst im Community Management den richtigen Ton, freundlich und auf Augenhöhe, auch wenn eine Kundin genervt schreibt.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security and control commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's-eye view of how well we're meeting them. We're building toward continuous assurance, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits.

As Anthropic prepares for life as a public company, the Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) control environment over our technology stack is one of the most consequential things this team owns. As part of Security GRC's technical controls assurance function, you will be the voice on what the IT general controls must achieve to support SOX 404 compliance. In partnership with Internal Audit, you will define control requirements and acceptance criteria for the in-scope engineering systems and infrastructure that underpin financial reporting. You will pair with engineering as they design and implement against those requirements, and validate that what ships actually meets the bar before Internal Audit and our external auditors test it. You are the product owner for control design methodology and continuous control monitoring, initially around ITGCs, but extending into other areas of security and compliance to drive visibility where and when we need it.

Key responsibilities

  • Define control requirements and acceptance criteria across the core ITGC domains of logical access, change management, computer operations, and program development for SOX in-scope systems, including home-built platforms where the control has to be designed into the system rather than bolted on.

  • Set the bar for in-scope systems from day one. As financially significant systems are built, migrated, or replaced, define what the system must provide (auditability, segregation of duties, change control, immutable logging, evidence retention) before go-live, so controls are not retrofitted after the fact.

  • Pressure-test changes for SOX impact during design. Review major infrastructure, system, and agent framework changes for control impact while decisions are still cheap, and maintain a clear view of which changes alter the SOX scope, key control population, or evidence requirements.

  • Own second-line control monitoring and evidence readiness. Stand up continuous controls monitoring and automated

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We launch new products, models and pricing often, and each launch has to work in our systems on day one. A seller needs to be able to quote it, Deal Desk needs to be able to approve it, billing needs to charge for it correctly, and Finance needs to report on it. This role owns how a launch gets into our quote-to-cash systems, from the first pricing conversation to the first invoice.

We are looking for someone who treats every launch as a change across many systems. You will join launch planning early, work out what has to change across catalog, quoting, contracts, billing, tax and reporting, and get all of it ready before the launch date. You will build a good part of the Salesforce work yourself and partner with our Salesforce developers and Billing Engineering on the rest. You will be the named owner of the NPI process for systems, and the person Product, Pricing and Finance call when they want to know what it takes to launch something.

We are an AI-first systems team. You will use Claude as a normal part of how you design, build, test and document, and you will look for ways to make launches faster and more repeatable with AI.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the systems side of new product and pricing launches, from the first pricing discussion through launch day and the first billing cycle

  • Turn a pricing and packaging decision into concrete system changes: SKUs, price books, bundles, discount and approval rules, contract terms, billing plans, tax codes and reporting

  • Build and run a repeatable NPI playbook: intake, a readiness checklist, sign-offs, a launch calendar and a post-launch review

  • Join launch planning early with Product and Pricing. Push back on pricing ideas that cannot be quoted, billed or reported cleanly, and offer options that can

  • Design how new pricing models work end to end, including usage-based, seat-based, tiered, committed and multi-year ramp pricing, and which system is the source of truth for each part

  • Plan the impact on existing customers: moving customers to new SKUs, grandfathering, amendments and co-termination, and how renewals will work

  • Own end-of-sale and retirement of products and prices, so old SKUs leave the catalog without breaking renewals, billing or reporting

  • Coordinate the changes across Salesforce, billing and our tax platform, working with the teams who own each system

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Inference / Compute Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a software engineer to build the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. You'll design a manifest-driven API where the inference team declares what they need, whether that's a cluster, a model deployment, or a capacity change, and our controllers handle the reconciliation, provider/runtime selection, and lifecycle management underneath, so the inference team never has to know or care which specific serving stack, scheduler, or hardware pool is doing the work. You'll also build the systems that keep the fleet efficient, not just running, including defragmentation and rebalancing logic that consolidates scattered workloads back into contiguous capacity, and scheduling/bin-packing improvements that push GPU utilization up without hurting latency.

The core value we're after is decoupling the people building on top of the platform from the operational and runtime complexity underneath, while squeezing more usable capacity out of the same hardware. You'll build the controllers, reconciliation loops, and self-service surface (API/CLI, not tickets) that make that decoupling real, plus the event-driven health, remediation, and utilization systems that keep it running and efficient without a human in the loop. Strong candidates have hands-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, have built or operated a platform API that abstracts multiple backends behind one interface, understand GPU scheduling and capacity efficiency (fragmentation, bin-packing, right-sizing), and think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered.

A product mindset - you've built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.You build it, you own it. You are not only responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

Responsibilities

  • Build the provisioning state machine: design and implement the software that models the full lifecycle of a physical host from discovery, inference bring-up to GPU driver/CUDA stack, health validation, and decommission/RMA — as explicit, versioned states and transitions.
  • Build the self-service API: design declarative APIs and a control plane so the inference team can request, scale, and tear down inference clusters with one API call — no ticket, no human in the loop.
  • Automate self-healing: detect degraded or failed nodes, drain them safely, trigger repair or replacement, and reintroduce healthy capacity into the pool automatically.
  • Own reliability of the pipeline: idempotency, retries, rollback, and drift detection so the provisioning system is as dependable as any other production service.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Distributed Storage and HPC & AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About the Role

In this role, you will operate, scale, and optimize multi-petabyte storage systems purpose-built for the world’s largest AI training and inference workloads. You’ll manage and scale high-performance parallel filesystems and object stores, evaluate and integrate cutting-edge technologies such as Vast, Weka, Ceph, and Lustre, and solve the complex engineering challenges of operating at extreme throughput, low-latency data paths, and massive cluster-scale storage operations.

You will also build Kubernetes-native storage operators and self-service platforms that provide automated provisioning, strict multi-tenancy, performance isolation, and quota enforcement at cluster scale. Day-to-day, you’ll optimize end-to-end data paths for 10-50 GB/s per node, design multi-tier caching architectures, implement intelligent prefetching and model-weight distribution, and tune parallel filesystems for AI workloads.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement the technical strategy and storage roadmap for Together AI, driving high-performance architectural decisions as we scale our GPU fleet.
  • Engineer and scale multi-petabyte AI/ML storage systems by integrating Vast, Weka, and Ceph while executing deep cost optimization through automated tiering and lifecycle policies.
  • Develop intelligent caching and tiered storage architectures to achieve extreme IOPS and cluster-wide throughput at GPU scale for training and inference workloads.
  • Tune storage isolation at the L2/L3 network layers to ensure secure, production-grade multi-tenancy for storage clients.
  • Code Kubernetes storage operators and controllers to enable automated provisioning, self-service abstractions, and quota enforcement.
  • Engineer end-to-end data paths to achieve 10+ GB/s per GPU node; architect multi-tier caching for model weights and datasets; tune parallel filesystems using advanced profiling; and scale storage infrastructure across thousands of nodes.
  • Optimize end-to-end data paths through advanced benchmarking and profiling, contributing high-impact code to open-source storage projects and internal tooling.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in storage engineering, managing distributed storage at multi-petabyte scale
  • Proven track record deploying and operating high-performance storage for GPU/HPC clusters
  • Deep Kubernetes and cloud-native storage experience in production environments
  • Strong coding skills in Go and Python with demonstrated ability to build production-grade systems and tooling
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • History of technical leadership: designing systems that significantly improved performance, reliability (99.999%+ uptime), or cost efficiency

Together AI is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to design, deploy, and operate the global network infrastructure supporting our production services and high-performance AI compute environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with deep networking expertise who can also troubleshoot across Linux, Kubernetes, automation, and application boundaries. You will work on large-scale, multi-vendor data center networks and help ensure they remain highly available, reliable, scalable, and performant.

The ideal candidate has strong networking fundamentals, experience operating complex networks at scale, and a structured, evidence-based approach to troubleshooting. You should be comfortable owning problems from initial investigation through root cause and resolution, including situations where the issue may extend beyond the network itself.

Together AI is building the best inference infrastructure for voice applications. Our Voice AI platform powers production-grade, real-time voice agents and applications — serving speech-to-text and text-to-speech models with best-in-class latency and reliability.

We're looking for a Staff ML Engineer to drive the model serving layer for voice workloads. You'll work hands-on with inference engines like TRT-LLM and SGLang to optimize how we serve models like Whisper, Parakeet, Orpheus, and Kokoro — pushing latency and throughput to the frontier. You'll profile GPU utilization, design batching strategies for streaming audio, and ensure new model architectures can go from research to production quickly.

This is a foundational hire on a small, high-impact team. Voice inference has unique challenges — streaming audio, tokenization, real-time latency budgets — that require dedicated ML engineering focus. You'll shape how Together serves voice models as the industry moves from pipeline architectures (ASR → LLM → TTS) toward end-to-end speech-to-speech.

  • Own the model serving stack that powers Together's voice platform across STT, TTS, and speech-to-speech.
  • Work directly with state-of-the-art accelerators (H100s, H200s, B200s) to optimize voice model inference.
  • Collaborate with model partners (Cartesia, Deepgram, Rime, and others) to bring their models to production on Together's infrastructure.
  • Build quality evaluation frameworks that guide model selection for customers and inform the roadmap.
  • Join a small, early-stage team with outsized impact on a fast-growing product area.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

Submit your application to the Economics & Policy workstream at the bottom of this page. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
  • Weekly stipend of 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Funding for compute (~$15k/month) and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application & reference check, assessments & interviews, and a research discussion.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Compensation

The expected base stipend for this role is 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension).

jobs.title: AI Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Karriere

Wir suchen  erfahrene AI Engineers,  die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du bist Softwareentwickler mit echter Engineering-Tiefe, idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Erfahrung, und du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht.  Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen.  Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst.

Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht.  Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können. Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team.

Deine Aufgaben

Konzeption, Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von KI-gestützten Softwarelösungen – von der ersten Idee bis in den stabilen Produktivbetrieb  Agentic Engineering: Entwurf und Umsetzung agentischer Systeme – Tool- und Function-Calling, Orchestrierung mehrstufiger Workflows, Kontext- und State-Management, Retries und Fallbacks, Human-in-the-Loop und sinnvolle Guardrails  Design und Umsetzung von LLM-Anwendungen: RAG-Pipelines, strukturierte Extraktion, Evaluation, Observability  Integration von ML-Modellen, Foundation Models und datengetriebenen Services in bestehende oder neue Systeme – inklusive der APIs, Datenflüsse und Infrastruktur drumherum  Hands-on-Entwicklung skalierbarer, wartbarer und performanter Anwendungen auf modernen Technologien und Cloud-Plattformen (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry o. ä.)  Identifikation von KI-Use-Cases in Kundenprojekten – und die ehrliche Einschätzung, wann ein Agent die richtige Antwort ist und wann eine deterministische Lösung die bessere  Agentic Coding im eigenen Arbeitsalltag: KI-Werkzeuge produktiv und verantwortungsvoll in Entwicklung, Review und Delivery einsetzen – und dem Team zeigen, wie es geht  Technologische Beratung unserer Kunden bei Architektur-, Technologie- und Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen  Sicher

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability 
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Anthropic is seeking an experienced Executive Communications Writer to support and scale the ways our leaders tell our story. These include: science and research; products and AI architecture; enterprise and commercial strategy; and visual storytelling and brand, among others.

Responsibilities:

  • Originate and shape exceptional executive communications that span a wide array of written and rhetorical formats and platforms
  • Work cross-functionally with External Communications colleagues and other subject matter experts to drive consequential communications moments that serve strategic goals
  • Support senior leaders in developing their areas of communications focus and in their preparation for major communications moments
  • Balance a collaborative ethic with a strategic point of view

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 8+ years of high level executive communications experience, ideally at a high-tempo, industry-shaping organization
  • Are an exceptional writer and communicator — both on the page, and in high-stakes, fast-moving environments
  • Are high agency and low ego
  • Demonstrate comfort and experience in supporting senior leaders

About The Opportunity

We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows.  We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches.

Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents.

Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language

职责 (Responsibilities):

战略规划与顶层架构 (Vision & Strategy)

  • 作为核心决策层，与制作人深度协同，制定产品的核心愿景、市场定位及长期战略。确立项目的宏观设计方向（核心循环、商业化模型、社交结构），确保设计目标与商业价值、IP内核高度对齐，构建竞争壁垒。

创意驱动与产品进化 (Innovation)

  • 敏锐洞察相关游戏品类痛点，不仅仅是复刻经典，主动提出具前瞻性的设计构想，推动团队做出超越现有热门游戏的差异化体验，满足用户深层需求。

落地执行与跨部门协同 (Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership)

  • 高质量执行： 负责将宏观战略转化为可执行的设计方案，能准确转达给策划团队，并确保顺利融入到游戏的体验中。
  • 资源整合： 作为设计团队对外的核心枢纽，与程序、美术、IP及发行团队建立紧密互信的合作关系，确保核心系统以高标准准时交付。

团队管理与建设 (Team Leadership)

  • 标准确立： 建立高标准的策划工作流、文档规范与评审机制，打造高效、透明、沉淀知识的团队文化。
  • 团队组建： 负责团队的招聘与梯队搭建，吸引顶尖人才；成为策划设计能力标杆，担任策划导师角色，通过绩效管理与专业辅导，提升策划团队专业水平。

  • 管理经验： 3年以上团队管理经验及团队建设的经历。
  • 专业度： 透彻理解游戏底层逻辑，能深度分析拆解主流品类趋势，并具备打破常规的创新设计能力。
  • 跨职能合作： 卓越的逻辑思维与沟通领导力，能推动跨职能团队达成共识。
  • 游戏阅历： 深入体验过至少两款主流手游。

加分项 (Desired Qualifications):

jobs.title: Senior Game Producer 高级游戏项目管理经理 - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

我们正在寻找一位拥有极高专业素养和卓越领导力的高级游戏项目管理经理，来管理公司旗下游戏项目。
作为项目管理者，你不仅仅是进度的记录者，更是项目研发体系的架构师和变革者。你的核心使命是：通过科学的项目管理方法论，建立可预测、高效率、透明化的研发管线，确保项目按时、保质、可控地交付，从而将宏大的游戏愿景变为现实。

核心职责 (Responsibilities):

  • 【项目管理】 制定并确立项目的制作与管理标准，在推进研发进度的同时，重点关注高质量的交付、管线效能以及团队的健康状态。
  • 【风险预警】 提供清晰、透明的项目进度与管线健康度更新。敏锐地识别开发中的潜在风险，并协调核心利益相关者及时跟进、解决或升级问题。
  • 【流程优化】 开发并持续优化跨职能团队的工作流与沟通渠道。打通策划、美术、程序等不同部门间的协作壁垒，消除无效沟通和返工摩擦。
  • 【协同对齐】 促进各研发部门在排期和优先级上保持紧密对齐，确保责任落实，让团队的承诺都能转化为按时的交付。

任职要求 (Qualifications):

  • 经验要求： 8年以上游戏行业游戏自研经验，至少拥有3年以上管理经验（管理过 PM 或同等职能团队），有从零到一的项目经验优先。
  • 项目背景： 必须具备大型、复杂游戏项目的全周期研发管理经验。熟悉主流游戏引擎开发流程。
  • 专业认证： 精通敏捷开发模式，并能根据项目特点灵活融合。持有 PMP 或 ACP/CSM 认证者优先。
  • 工具精通： 专家级掌握 Jira 等项目管理工具、Excel/Tableau 等数据分析工具，并了解版本控制系统（如 Perforce/Git）及 CI/CD 流程。

加分项 (Pluses):

  • 英语流利，能适应国际化办公环境
  • 有全球化发行或跨国团队协作的项目管理经验。

jobs.title: Senior Concept Artist, Environment - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
我们以玩家体验为核心，致力于用创新技术为全球玩家带来卓越的游戏体验。作为 Unpublished R&D Product 团队的一员，你将与客户端、引擎、美术、设计及跨职能团队紧密合作，围绕 UE5 前沿能力开展研究与工程化实践，持续完善高品质、稳定高效的视觉设计流程。

我们正在寻找能够"构建设计体验，而不仅是绘制场景"的设计师。

作为一名优秀的场景设计师，你将从空间体验与视觉表达出发，定义环境设计的视觉语言，与美术、设计、叙事及技术团队紧密合作，打造兼具沉浸感、可读性与制作可行性的高品质环境内容。

我们希望你不仅具备出色的视觉表达能力，更具备系统化的空间设计思维，能够在艺术表现、设计需求与技术约束之间建立平衡。

You will report into the Creative Director of the team.

Responsibilities

Environment Design

  • 负责核心场景内容的概念设计，从草图探索到高完成度场景设定。
  • 探索并定义符合设计方向的环境视觉语言，包括地形结构、建筑风格、材质表现、色彩氛围等。
  • 构建具有高度辨识度和沉浸感的环境设计，支撑整体体验与视觉表达。

Design Systems & Methodology

  • 构建场景设计逻辑，包括空间布局、视觉语言、设计原则及叙事关联。
  • 建立并持续完善场景设计规范，包括尺度体系、模块化原则、细节密度及视觉引导等。
  • 在设计中平衡视觉表现、空间可读性及长期内容扩展需求。

Spatial Design & Collaboration

  • 与跨职能团队紧密合作，确保场景设计满足空间体验及整体设计目标。
  • 设计清晰的视觉引导与空间层级，提升整体体验及信息传达效率。
  • 在空间规划过程中充分考虑功能分区、视觉可读性及制作可行性。

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • 与3D场景美术、技术美术及技术团队密切合作，确保设计方案具备良好的制作可行性及稳定表现。
  • 提供清晰、可执行的设计交付，包括结构拆解、模块建议、材质指引等。
  • 持续跟进场景从概念到最终实现的整体质量。

Quality

  • 参与整体环境视觉风格建设，建立关键区域的视觉质量标准。
  • 根据产品需求及目标平台要求，平衡设计复杂度与制作成本。
  • 在探索阶段提供多方向设计方案，快速支持设计迭代。

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Financial Accountant
jobs.description:
As Financial Accountant (EMEA) in the Riot Games Dublin office you will support senior leadership in Europe by managing reporting, compliance and processes. You will handle preparation of statutory statements and assist with annual fiscal audits in an EMEA environment with a broad awareness of financial and legal implications. You will report to the Accounting Manager. Your rock-solid judgment and integrity will help you keep everyone on the right track while you work to set up and maintain best-in-class processes and systems.

This role will be based in the Dublin City Centre office on a hybrid basis.

Responsibilities:

  • Participate in all activities related to full-cycle accounting, including building journal entries, reconciling general ledger accounts, preparing monthly reporting packages, answering questions
    from the central accounting team and researching and resolving discrepancies.
  • Drive the entire year-end financial process including coordination with the external audit team, tax advisors and sign-off on the local financial statements across all jurisdictions.
  • Responsible for a number of Riot subsidiary companies and their compliance. This will require cross collaboration across various teams such as Talent, Legal, Treasury and others.

  • Maintain a tight monthly reporting schedule according to established time-frames
  • Investigate fluctuations and monitor trends in the accounts. Work with other teams to gain a deep understanding of the story behind the movements.

jobs.title: Senior Esports Events Production Manager
jobs.description:
As a Senior Production Manager on Riot’s Esports Events team, you’ll be a senior operational leader driving the planning and execution of high-complexity, high-visibility esports productions across EMEA. You will work on flagship events such as LEC Finals, VCT EMEA Finals, or cross-regional tournaments and other product initiatives, ensuring operational excellence across multiple vendors, geographies, and formats.

You’ll report to Sr. Manager, Esports Event Production EMEA and act as the regional authority on large-scale production delivery, setting standards, innovating workflows, and ensuring alignment with global broadcast teams. You’ll lead through influence, mentoring peers, guiding vendors, and acting as a key escalation and decision-making point for production operations.

You’ll blend strategic foresight with hands-on operational execution, ensuring every aspect of Riot’s physical, broadcast, and hospitality experience meets the highest standards of safety, quality, and fan engagement.

Please role will be based on site in Berlin.

Responsibilities:

Production Ownership

  • Lead planning and operational delivery for Riot’s largest regional or international esports events hosted in EMEA.
  • Define operational roadmaps and resourcing plans across multiple productions.
  • Partner with senior Producers and regional leadership to align on event vision, scope, and budget.
  • Represent EMEA in global Content Services alignment — sharing learnings, best practices, and process innovations.

Physical Production Leadership

  • Own physical production design and execution for large-scale or multi-venue events.
  • Oversee integration of scenic, lighting, AV, staging, led/projection, power, and rigging with broadcast and creative workflows.
  • Manage health, safety, permitting, and risk mitigation across venues.
  • Partner with Facilities and Event Production on load-in/out logistics, transport, and crew deployment.

Hospitality Strategy & Oversight

  • Coordinate hospitality frameworks for players, talent, and VIPs across Tier-1 events.
  • Align hospitality and travel schedules with show operations.
  • Ensure welfare, accessibility, and inclusivity standards are met for all participants.
  • Partner with Player Management and Events teams to maintain Riot’s hospitality excellence.

Budget & Financial Leadership

  • Own production budgets for Tier-1 events and major seasonal shows.
  • Partner with Finance and Global Esports to forecast costs and manage capital investment decisions.

jobs.title: Warehouse and Logistics Manager - North America
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Infrastructure organization builds and operates the compute that trains and serves our frontier models. Behind every cluster is a physical supply chain: servers, accelerators, networking equipment, spares, and tooling that have to be received, inspected, secured, tracked, and delivered to the right site at the right time. The Warehousing and Logistics team owns that flow, and this role runs its day-to-day operations in the US.

As Warehouse and Logistics Manager, you'll report to our Global Warehousing and Logistics Lead and own the operational management of all direct and third party logistics providers) of inbound receiving, storage, inventory control, kitting, and outbound shipments to our data center sites and partners. You'll manage the relationships and performance of our third-party warehouses, carriers, and freight forwarders, and you'll be the person on the ground when a shipment is late, a pallet arrives damaged, or a site needs a critical spare tomorrow morning.

This is a hands-on operational role on a small team, so you'll move between running the daily floor rhythm and building the processes, controls, and metrics that let us scale as our hardware footprint grows. You should be comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, communicating clearly with engineers and vendors alike, and holding a high bar for accuracy and chain of custody on high-value, security-sensitive equipment.

Key responsibilities

  • Oversee the day-to-day warehouse operations across locations in North America, including receiving, inspection, put-away, storage, cycle counting, kitting, and outbound fulfillment to data center sites for the Anthropic owned warehouse and those run by Anthropic’s partners/ third party logistics providers

  • Own inventory accuracy and asset tracking for all infrastructure hardware, compute, MEP, spares, and consumables, maintaining clear chain of custody from dock to rack

  • Plan and execute domestic freight and coordinate international shipments, selecting carriers, managing schedules, and resolving exceptions such as delays, damage, and shortages

  • Manage third-party logistics providers, carriers, and freight forwarders, including onboarding, service-level tracking, performance reviews, and cost management

  • Coordinate closely with data center operations, hardware engineering, procurement, and security teams to align delivery schedules with deployment timeline

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

The AI Engineering team builds the systems and capabilities behind Typeform’s products.

We use machine learning, large language models, RAG, and agentic systems to help customers collect, understand, and act on information in more conversational and personalised ways.

The team owns the journey from experimentation through to production. This includes AI application development, evaluation, infrastructure, deployment, observability, reliability, and performance.

Your work will span generative AI applications, enterprise RAG systems, agentic workflows, model evaluation, machine learning pipelines, and the infrastructure required to run them reliably at scale.

This is a hands on engineering role with strong ownership. You will help turn ideas and prototypes into production systems used by our customers. You will also help define the technical standards for developing, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring AI across Typeform.

Build and deliver AI products

  • Use MLflow to manage experiments, model versions, registries, and deployments.

We are hiring a Head of Brand to own how Pairs shows up in the world. The brand, the content behind it, the video we put out, and the small team that makes it with you.  Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

You own the brand. What Pairs says, where it says it, how it looks, and the image a founder or investor meets before they ever talk to us. You set the strategy and you run it. Most weeks that means one or two high-value posts in the founders' voices and one or two from the company. You run the story shoots with the founders and investors we work with, from booking the guest through to the final cut, and you cut video yourself. Paid comes later, once we turn it on, and you own the brief behind every campaign. You also get a team, VC Content Interns who live in this space, write daily, and grow into full-time seats under you. You report to the co-founders, strategize with them, and get real creative freedom.  This is a player-coach seat and both halves are real. People who stopped writing and editing when they got their first team will not enjoy this. Neither will someone who has never had anyone reporting to them, though we will hear the case.  All of it is aimed at one thing. When a founder or an investor asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google how raising capital works and who to raise with, we want Pairs quoted back, and we want what gets quoted to be good.

Positioning, voice and look, held consistent everywhere from the site to the feed to the newsroom.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

More broadly, Discord is about empowering people to find belonging in all kinds of communities, and those people trust us to keep their communications safe. Our Platform Security Engineering team protects the systems we use to create Discord, making the "secure way" the "easy way."

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to advance this mission through security expertise, software development, and operational excellence, with a particular focus on identity and access management: who and what can access Discord's systems, how they authenticate, and how access stays scoped to what's actually needed. You'll help identify leveraged opportunities to reduce security risk across Engineering, then design and deliver technical solutions: lovable "paved paths" for managing identities and access, shipping code, configuring cloud infrastructure, and operating services.

If you're a security engineer with a deep interest in identity and access management, who's eager to own technically and socially complex projects, and excited to improve security and privacy at Discord, read on!

What you'll do

  • Own software engineering projects end-to-end on a highly autonomous, horizontally integrated team with a lot of leverage. This is a code-forward role!
  • Define what identity means for autonomous agents and other non-human actors at Discord (how they're provisioned, scoped, authenticated, authorized, and audited). As the role of these actors grows, and create primitives to implement that vision.
  • Build and evolve Access, Discord's employee authorization platform, to make permissions discoverable, role-based, least privilege, and self-serve; check out our blog post to learn more!
  • Design and harden our Zero Trust architecture, spanning human and service-to-service auth*n for Discord’s internal tooling.
  • Automate continuous permission right-sizing in the spirit of least privilege.
  • Develop and apply secure baselines for cloud identity, and help secure our software supply chain from the dev environment through CI/CD and into production.

jobs.title: Senior Thermal Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Mission Brief

You will be responsible for defining the thermal environment and architecture of the vehicle, ranging from detailed thermal modeling and system level coupled loads analyses and to active and passive thermal control design. You will be in charge of the development, execution, and correlation of thermal models using FEM/FDM/FVM tools and test data. The decisions you make will directly support hardware qualification, test planning, and system-level design choices, ultimately enhancing the thermal robustness, performance, and reliability of the vehicle throughout its mission.

Your Role in Our Space Mission:

  • Own the vehicle-level thermal architecture, including active and passive thermal control design for the avionic components and payloads
  • Perform Thermal Coupled Loads Analysis and develop detailed thermal models using FEM and/or FVM, FDM methods
  • Develop, execute, and correlate thermal models using tools such as SIMCenter, STAR-CCM+ and Thermal Desktop supported by component tests and flight data
  • Review, assess, and approve component- and assembly-level designs for thermal flight readiness
  • Create and maintain specifications and design documentation such as Fluid Plans, Test Plans and Procedures, Test and Analysis Reports, Instrumentation Plans, Work Instructions etc.
  • Develop tools, workflows, and standards to improve efficiency, consistency, and repeatability across thermal engineering activities
  • Support integration, test, and launch-site operations as subject-matter expert on system thermal performance
  • Support with your expertise other technical departments

Qualification Checklist

  • Degree in the field of Aerospace of Mechanical Engineering, or similar
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in the field of aerospace and thermal
  • Experience with thermal simulation tools (e.g. ANSYS, SIMCenter, Thermal Desktop)
  • Experience with coding (e.g. Python, MATLAB)
  • Holistic perspective on development of systems 
  • Highly organized and proactive with high attention to detail 
  • Good communication and organizational skills 
  • Fluent in English

Aufgaben

Du bist unser erster Customer Success Manager – das Bindegewebe zwischen Kunde und Produkt. Onboarding end-to-end verantworten. Von der Übergabe aus dem Vertrieb bis zur produktiven Nutzung: Systeme anbinden, Playbooks einstellen, Dispatcher schulen.

Customer Success skalierbar machen. Onboarding, Schulung und Erfolgsmessung baust du so, dass sie beim zehnten Kunden noch funktionieren.

Du passt zu uns, wenn…

du Kunden nicht betreust, sondern Ergebnisse verantwortest – Operator, kein Account Manager.

du die Hausverwaltung von innen kennst oder schnell lernst, wie ein Objektbetreuer denkt, priorisiert und wo er die Geduld verliert.

du komplexe Themen so erklärst, dass nicht-technische Kunden sie verstehen – mit Klarheit und Geduld.

du bei vielen parallelen Onboardings den Überblick behältst und pragmatisch priorisierst.

Nachweisbarer Erfolg beim Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen mit messbaren Ergebnissen

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project.
